tasks.label: Rebuild and Run
args: taskkill -IM bejeweled-bot.exe -F 2>/dev/null || true; cmake --build builds/msbuild-vcpkg --config Debug && ./builds/msbuild-vcpkg/Debug/bejeweled-bot.exe

tasks.label: Rebuild and Run (Release)
args: taskkill -IM bejeweled-bot.exe -F 2>/dev/null || true; cmake --build builds/msbuild-vcpkg --config Release && ./builds/msbuild-vcpkg/Release/bejeweled-bot.exe
